Digimon World 4 (GDJEB2) - "Aim on fire" v2: 180 deg + more range
====================================================================
Same as before, but it turns toward the nearest enemy in ANY direction (180 deg
each way) and reaches much farther. Use ONE of these; turn off the older aim-on-fire codes.
